answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Mountain rescue team roster entry. It demands a team roster held by the rescue service, and the hollow is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. What makes this stick is that a team roster held by the rescue service cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the kernel of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. Time is the tax here: a team roster held by the rescue service cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the atlas for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
